title: Search, filters, sorting and scrolling keep working in bulk mode
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-INMODE-01, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL in mode Alpha") is active at {Location-A}, in category {Category-A} (for example the first category offered).
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-INMODE-02, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL in mode Bravo") is active, in category {Category-B} (for example the second category offered).
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-INMODE-03, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL in mode Charlie") is active, in {Category-A}.
  • All three part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-INMODE).
  • {Location-A} has more than 30 active parts in all (any parts; this case changes none of them).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  5. Open the Category filter and pick {Category-A}.
  6. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  7. Click the Description column header.
  8. Click the Description column header again.
  9. Clear the Search box.
  10. Scroll the list down to the bottom.
  11. Click the X at the right end of the bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The search works with the bar still on screen: {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C} are listed, each with a checkbox.
  • Step 5: The filter works: only {Part-A} and {Part-C} are listed.
  • Step 6: All three are listed again.
  • Steps 7 and 8: Sorting works: the rows are ordered by Description, and the second click reverses the order ({Part-A}, {Part-B}, {Part-C}, then {Part-C}, {Part-B}, {Part-A}).
  • Step 10: More rows load as you scroll (the list loads 30 at a time), each with a checkbox, and the bar stays on screen.
  • Step 11: Bulk mode ends and no part changed status.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S2-R10, §4 Key Decisions, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.2 (Mode on), board 4.3 (Two rows ticked), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R10: “Search, the filter bar, sorting and paging keep working while the mode is on, as they do in Cycle count.”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (Bulk status change is a mode): “Bulk status change is a mode. A row click on the Inventory list opens the part. Bulk status uses the same pattern as Cycle count: the user turns the mode on from the actions menu, checkboxes appear, search and filtering keep working, and the X on the bulk bar leaves the mode.”
